ON THE 11th OF SEPTEMBER, 2024  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 34752 of 2024  RAVI  Versus  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH AND OTHERS  Appearance:
 Shri Omprakash Solanki, learned counsel for the appli  Shri Santosh Singh Thakur, learned counsel for the re  Shri Subham Dholpure, learned counsel for the objecto  ORDER

This is third application filed under section 439 of CrP.C in crime no.76/2022 under sections 376,
363, 366, 368, 342, 506 of IPC and 3/4 of POCSO Act registered at police station Shujalpur City,
District Shajapur.

The applicant was granted bail in M.Cr.C No.33507/2022 by order dated 04.08.2022 considering the statement of the prosecutrix under section 164 of Cr.P.C that she has not made any allegation of forcible marriage or forcible intercourse by the applicant.
In MLC, there was no sign of forcible intercourse.
As per the scholar register, the age of the prosecutrix is nearing 18 years i.e. 17 years 8 months and 15 days.

The application for cancellation of bail was filed by the father of the prosecutrix in M.Cr.C No.52384/2022, which was dismissed on the ground that the statement of the prosecutrix has NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:26470 2 MCRC-34752-2024 already been recorded and the counsel for the applicant assured the court that he will not threaten the prosecutrix.
Thereafter, the State filed an application for cancellation of bail in M.Cr.C No.454/2022.
The present applicant despite service was not present.

sentences.text: Considering the submission that after grant of bail, the respondent has committed two offences.

FIR No.339/2022 dated 27.10.2022 for offense punishable under sections 294, 306, 190 of IPC and another FIR no.405/2022 dated 26.12.2022 for offence punishable under section 323, 294, 506,
190, 34 of IPC and the fact that the FSL report was found positive and in absence of the representation of the present applicant, the bail was canceled.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that after the cancellation of bail, the applicant has been arrested and at present, he is in jail since 12.04.2024. It is further submitted that the statement of the prosecutrix and parents have already been recorded and therefore, the grounds that the applicant may threaten the prosecutrix or influence the prosecutrix witnesses do not exist.
Learned counsel for the respondent/state and the prosecutrix opposed the prayer and submits that by committing the subsequent offence, for which a complaint was lodged by the father of the prosecutrix, no case is made out for grant of bail.

After considering the court statement of the prosecutrix on the basis of which the earlier bail was granted and the fact that now the statement of the parents have already been recorded, the ground of the objector that the applicant may threaten or influence the prosecution witnesses do not exist.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:26470 3 MCRC-34752-2024
The applicant is in jail since 12.04.2024.

Therefore, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed on the following conditions:-
i) The applicant shall mark his presence before the concerned Police Station on 15th of every month during the trial and shall attend all the dates before the trial Court.
ii) The applicant shall not indulge in any offence during the trial.
If the applicant indulges in any offence during the trial, the prosecution shall be at liberty to apply for cancellation of bail.

It is directed that applicant shall be released from custody upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Ld. Court below.
A typed copy of this order is being forwarded to the Office of the Advocate General, on their email address, for intimation to the Police Station concerned.
The office is requested to forward a copy of this order to the Ld. Court below.
(VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA) JUDGE Sourabh Ravi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 September, 2024
